column1: # AQL Language Specification: `super` — base-dispatch delegation, and the
# pure-AQL sorted-node enablers (design/OPEN-WORDS.1.md follow-ups)
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# Three seams make user-module container subtypes (FLEX-ATTRS.1 D4)
# expressible in pure AQL:
#   1. `super name/q` returns a Function wrapping the word's PRISTINE
#      builtin dispatch table — call-by-value (quote-capture cleared),
#      so an anchored override body can delegate to the base overloads
#      without re-entering itself.
#   2. A bare refine of a FLEX type retags flex handles through typed
#      def (`def w:S (flex m)`) — check and runtime agree; the tag
#      survives in-place writes because flex words return the receiver.
#   3. A fn-bodied capitalised def (`def Sorted ([m:Map] => [pred])`)
#      is a CONTENT-predicate type over containers; params dispatch on
#      the predicate. (Content types cannot ANCHOR extensions — the
#      OPEN-WORDS.1 §3.1 nominality rule — classification only.)
# §1  super — the base dispatch as a value
def bset (super set)  typeof (bset/r)
column3: super returns the pristine builtin dispatch as a Function

column1: def bset (super set)  def m (flex { })  (bset 'a' 1 m) drop keys m
column3: the delegated write runs the KERNEL set — no merged overloads

column1: def bset (super set)  def k b/q  def m (flex { })  (bset k 2 m) drop keys m
column3: delegation is CALL-BY-VALUE: k passes its BINDING, never the literal word (quote-capture is cleared)

column1: super nosuchword
column3: an unknown word has no base

column1: def myfn fn [[x:Integer] [Integer] [x]]  super myfn
column3: a plain user fn has no hidden base — call it directly

column1: # §2  refine-of-flex retag — nominal subtypes of mutable containers
def S (refine FlexMap)  def w:S (flex {b:2 a:1})  typeof w
column3: typed def retags a flex handle to the newtype (the flex-retag gap, fixed)

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def w:S (flex {b:2 a:1})  (set c/q 3 w) drop typeof w
column3: the tag survives an in-place write — flex words return the receiver handle

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def w:S (flex {a:1})  w.a
column3: reads dispatch the inherited flex vocabulary

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def w:S (flex {b:2 a:1})  w is FlexMap
column3: nominal subtyping: an S is a FlexMap

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def w:S (flex {b:2 a:1})  w
column3: a newtype value renders by its payload family, not as an opaque wrapper

column1: def L (refine FlexList)  def v:L (flex [1 2])  typeof v
# §3  content-predicate types over containers (classification)
def Sorted ([m:Map] => [(keys m) deq (sort (keys m))])  def f fn [[m:Sorted] [Integer] [size m]]  f {a:1 b:2}
column3: a map satisfying the predicate dispatches the Sorted param

column1: def Sorted ([m:Map] => [(keys m) deq (sort (keys m))])  def f fn [[m:Sorted] [Integer] [size m]]  f (set a/q 1 (set b/q 2 { }))
column3: an unsorted map is refused at dispatch (content, not provenance)

column1: # §4  the composition — an anchored override delegating to its base
def S (refine FlexMap)  def bset (super set)  def set fn [[k:Atom/q v:Any m:S] [S] [(bset k v m)]]  def w:S (flex { })  (set a/q 1 w) drop keys w
column3: the anchored subtype override dispatches and its body delegates to the kernel set through super — no recursion

column1: def S (refine FlexMap)  def bset (super set)  def set fn [[k:Atom/q v:Any m:S] [S] [(bset k v m)]]  (set b/q 2 (flex {a:1}))
column3: a PLAIN flex value never sees the override (reachability)
